answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 150691 Country: Bangladesh Title: I have purchased a goods in 100 tk and I sell this product 500 tk. I want to know this is halal or haram. Question: I have purchased a goods in 100 tk and I sell this product 500 tk. I want to know this is halal or haram. Answer ID: 150691 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 930/899/SN=8/1438) If you do not deceive or lie at the time of selling then it shall be lawful for you according to Shariah to sell the goods of 100 taka in 500 taka. And the profit shall also be halal for you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
